listeners.description: List of listeners to expose (port, optional bind address, protocol). Each defines a listening endpoint.

port.description: TCP port number to listen on (e.g., 1883 for MQTT, 8883 for TLS).

bind_address.description: IP address or hostname to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

allow_zero_length_clientid.description: Allow clients to connect with an empty client ID (disables automatic client ID assignment).

allow_anonymous.description: If true, permits connections without username/password authentication. Set to false to require auth.

password_file.description: Absolute path to the file containing usernames and hashed passwords (use mosquitto_passwd to create).

acl_file.description: Absolute path to the file defining access control lists (permissions per user or pattern).

persistence.description: Enable disk persistence of subscriptions, retained messages, and in-flight messages.

persistence_location.description: Directory where persistence files are stored (must exist and be writable by mosquitto user).

max_inflight_messages.description: Maximum number of QoS 1/2 messages in-flight per client (not yet acknowledged).

max_packet_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an incoming MQTT packet (set to 0 for no limit; recommended ≤256MB).

connection_messages.description: Log client connect/disconnect messages to the log.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections (−1 = unlimited).

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file (requires proper permissions and directory).

log_type.description: List of log message types to record (options: none, error, warning, notice, information, subscribe, unsubscribe, websockets, audit, debug).

log_timestamp.description: Include ISO 8601 timestamps in log entries.

tls_certfile.description: Absolute path to the server’s TLS certificate (PEM format).

tls_keyfile.description: Absolute path to the server’s TLS private key (PEM format, unencrypted).

tls_cafile.description: Absolute path to the CA certificate (PEM format) for client cert verification.

tls_require_certificate.description: Require clients to present a valid certificate (for TLS-only or mutual TLS).

autosave_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic persistence file saves. Set to 0 to disable timed saves.

autosave_on_changes.description: Save the persistence file immediately after any change to persisted data.

retained_cache_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the retained message cache (0 = unlimited).

retained_persistence.description: Persist retained messages to disk (requires persistence=true for full effect).

bridges.description: Outgoing bridge connections to other MQTT brokers (e.g., for geo-redundancy or cloud sync).

remote_address.description: Hostname or IP of the remote broker.

remote_port.description: Port of the remote broker (usually 1883 or 8883).

client_id.description: Client ID used when connecting to the remote broker. If omitted, auto-generated.

username.description: Username for authentication on the remote broker.

password.description: Password for authentication on the remote broker.

attempt_unsubscribe.description: Send UNSUBSCRIBE on disconnect to clean up remote subscriptions.

try_private.description: Use the MQTT 'private' clean session flag (prevents message queuing for offline clients).

notifications.description: Publish bridge connection status to $SYS bridge state topics.

topics.description: List of topics to bridge (direction and pattern).
